getRunningScripts.description: Returns a table with paths of all running Lua scripts.

callScript.description: Calls a function in another running Lua script and returns its result.

parameters.luaFile: Path to the target Lua script.
parameters.funcName: Function to call in the target script.
parameters.args: Optional arguments passed to the target function.

addLuaScript.description: Adds a Lua script without immediately running callbacks.

parameters.ignoreAlreadyRunning: Skip if already running. Defaults to false.

isRunning.description: Checks if a script is currently running.

setVar.description: Saves a variable accessible to all scripts.
examples: Stores a numeric value for other scripts.

getVar.description: Gets a variable saved with setVar.

callOnScripts.description: Calls a function on all running scripts.

parameters.ignoreStops: Ignore return false. Defaults to false.
parameters.ignoreSelf: Ignore calling script. Defaults to true.
parameters.exclusions: Scripts to exclude. Defaults to null.

examples: Calls function with arguments on all scripts.

runHaxeCode.description: Runs Haxe code inside a Lua script.

parameters.varsToBring: Variables to expose to Haxe. Defaults to null.
parameters.funcToRun: Function to run after code. Defaults to null.
